parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility ban, custody rule or documented police/border targeting is shown, and the same-sex statutes are reported unenforced in 2023, so the latent 10-year statute is a secondary, not dominating, factor. However, in this thin-data dossier there is also no documented social acceptance of gender diversity, no anti-discrimination recourse, and documented LGBTIQ discrimination, harassment and violence with fear of prosecution inhibiting police reporting - tier-3 societal hostility with no realistic remedy. Absence of LGR/protections is a resident gap, not a visitor deduction, but it extrapolates only as weak climate signal. Border, custody, healthcare and trans-specific violence are unknown, which is not safety. This sits below acceptance-with-working-remedies cases, above unremedied universal-exposure/targeting cases.
